level_definition: median of the monthly dipwell readings across the recorded network (01_wells_all + D-166 months), m, 0 at ground
area_definition: hectares on the slack floors, scaled to the whole warren by the scene's clear fraction; NOT a flood map (D-177)
curve_form: area_ha = a * exp(b * h); sigma is a log-space factor (x/div sigma_factor)

classes.open_water: B8 <= 0.50 x the scene's clear-floor median

cells.order: row-major, row 0 = NORTH edge (top), column 0 = WEST edge (left)
cells.units: centimetres of median well level (0 = ground)
cells.encoding: base64 of an int16 array, one value per 10 m cell: the median well level at which the cell switches into the class; 32767 = never seen in the class, seen in fewer than 10 scenes, or not on the phase 29 floor. NOTE the asymmetry with `curves`: `cells.wet_floor` is the DARK-TOTAL switching level (B8 <= 0.80 x median, i.e. open water OR wet floor), exactly as sentinel_wet_floor._animate uses it — draw it as the yellow layer and overdraw open water in blue; the wet-floor-only cells are (wet_floor <= h) AND NOT (open_water <= h). `curves.wet_floor` is the RING alone (0.50-0.80).

fit.definition: modelled_h_recurrence_m against observed_h_m over every well-month carrying both; rho is Spearman

history.definition: the SSM's monthly median well level (phase 27 recurrence) driving the curves, D-178 item 3; mode R is the one the film animates

caveat: cells switch at the level Sentinel-2 saw them switch in 2016-2026; an illustration of the area model on the Sentinel grid, not a prediction of where water will stand (D-177)
